materialPolicy.scope: Local duplicate of the avatar body material only; head and opacity materials remain unchanged.

accessoryAnchorPolicy.method: Child Of constraint to a named pose bone with inverse matrix at the current frame.

materialVariant.description: Muted brown-grey supervisor jacket over the existing woven texture.

knownLimitations: The base avatar remains administrative; helmet and clipboard must carry the role at game scale.
Accessories are simple offline geometry and require human review for silhouette and period fit.

materialVariant.description: Worn brown workwear over the existing denim texture.

knownLimitations: The source is the current chr_worker avatar; helmet and belt must differentiate it from the generic citizen and old crew sprite.
No toolbox is carried in this first recipe to avoid a floating hand prop.

materialVariant.description: Grey-olive workwear with a different material family from worker A.

knownLimitations: The base avatar is also used by chr_police; cap, olive tint and tool bag must establish a separate worker identity.
The bag is anchored to the hand and must be checked through both walk poses.

materialVariant.description: Slate-blue maintenance clothing with matte local shading.

knownLimitations: The base avatar is also used by chr_medical; cap, slate tint, bag and wrench must establish a maintenance identity.
The wrench is deliberately small and non-threatening.

materialVariant.description: Very dark charcoal-brown clothing over a neutral dark shirt, with the source specular texture removed.

knownLimitations: The base avatar is also used by chr_firefighter; cap, collar and lapels must establish a separate enforcement identity.
No weapon is present by design.

materialVariant.description: Dark plum-charcoal heavy clothing with matte local shading.

knownLimitations: The base avatar is also used by chr_medical; long coat panels and hat must create a distinct enforcement silhouette.
Coat panels are simple geometry and require human review for clipping and period fit.
